office-of-the-chief-minister.note: Names are from the Key Officials page, which lists each unit with its head but prints no position titles; titles given are the position the 2021 org chart prints for that office (e.g. Director III) and are null where it prints none. The Key Officials page lists Abdullah M. Cusain under a second "Office of the Senior Minister" card; the org chart has a Senior Minister and an Assistant Senior Minister, so he is likely the Assistant Senior Minister (unconfirmed; an MFBM post of 2024-10-02 calls him "former BARMM’s Assistant Senior Minister" on his appointment as MFBM Deputy Minister). Information and Communications Office and Protocol Division cards carry no name. Protocol Division is placed under the Office of the Chief of Staff because the charter’s OCOS service (p.24) routes to it; the Key Officials page has a "Chief - Protocol Division" card with no name. The charter (2023) prints no directory of officials; its PDF page numbers are cited for units it alone names (BAGO divisions, BLOMM services, programs).

The page itself gives no hierarchy, so divisions are nested under the services that BAA 13 Sec. 9 assigns them to, and field offices under BAA 13 Sec. 10-11. BAA 13 provides an Internal Audit Section (no head listed on the site). "Bangsamoro READi & SGAFO" is one record (head Muhammad Farzieh B. Abutazil); SGAFO presumably means the SGA field office. The Special Geographic Area Development Authority is created under MILG by BAA 13 Sec. 15; its Administrator is listed as "MP Mohammad Kelie U. Antao". A Sulu Provincial Field Office is still listed. The site links a 2019 citizen’s charter PDF (milg-app-content S3), not read.

The 2026 chart draws Administrative and Finance Services where the brackets of both Directors General meet; it is placed under the DG for ENR, which is uncertain. The Energy service is "Energy Management and Development Services" on the 2026 chart and directory but "Energy Development Services" on the 2021 chart; the directory lists no director for it. The directory still has a single "Maguindanao Province" PENREO and a Sulu PENREO, while the 2026 chart has PENREOs for Maguindanao del Norte and del Sur and none for Sulu; both directory entries are kept as separate rows. Releases also name MENRE staff (e.g. a Chief Environmental Management Specialist) not tied to a unit; not included. No citizen’s charter (MENRE’s charter page says "will be updated soon").

ministry-of-finance-and-budget-and-manag.note: Structure from the two-part MFBM org chart (2025-04). MFBM publishes no officials directory and its citizen’s charter lists offices without names, so every name comes from an MFBM news post (mfbm.bangsamoro.gov.ph), with that post’s date. Doubtful: Deputy Minister Abdullah M. Cusain is last named in MFBM posts in 2025-02, and the OCM Key Officials page (2026-06) lists him under the Office of the Senior Minister, so the MFBM deputy post may have changed. Farrel/Farrell Hazsan E. Usman is "BFO Director" on 2026-07-27 and FPDD chief on 2026-01-20; Atty. Hanamir N. Emblawa is BRO OIC (2026) and was RPDD chief on 2025-12-25; Alameda Hajim M. Andong was OIC of the BFO on 2026-05-12. The LLLD had Atty. Rasul Salik as chief on 2025-12-25 and Atty. Naferteri M. Kuit as OIC on 2026-05-12 (the newer one is used). Treasurer’s surname appears as both "Dimaraw" and "Dimaraw-Macacua". BFO chart says "Strategies, Economics and Results Division"; BFO page cites BAA 13 as "Strategy, Economics, and Results Division".
